Since local swap affects only temporal quality without impacting the spatial quality of the video, an ideal metric should consistently provide low temporal scores as the number of local swaps increases, regardless of resolution.

Therefore, ideal temporal metrics should adeptly capture the extent of temporal distortion with respect to video length.

# Fréchet Video Motion Distance: A Metric for Evaluating Motion Consistency in Videos
### Abstract
Despite the impressive progress, research on metrics for evaluating the quality of generated videos, especially concerning temporal and motion consistency, remains underexplored. Further, we carry out a human study, demonstrating that our metric effectively detects temporal noise and aligns closely with human perceptions of generated video quality.
